name: Ulfa
title: Chandler
examine: Warm as her own dips and twice as busy. Every story in town passes through the chandlery, gets trimmed, and burns a little brighter after.
lines: A barrel a week, just for the road lamps. Think on that when you walk it at night.
Candles for the living, lamps for the road, and no questions for either.
You smell of the fell. Everyone does. It is fine.
